values: Summons ghosts to bombard random enemies on the battlefield.
召唤10道幽魂，幽魂会对随机敌人造成110% + 15% ATK伤害，持续10秒。幽魂造成伤害时，雪米拉会获得等同于伤害量50% + 5%的治疗，幽魂返回时，雪米拉会获得等同于伤害量50% + 5%的治疗，施放终极技能后，每名敌人累计受到15次及以上的伤害时，幽魂造成的伤害降低至50%。被动地，大招持续期间，通过“换命夺魂”凝聚的幽魂也会参与攻击。

Passive. Any ghosts summoned by Ghastly Tribute join the bombardment.
Active. Shemira summons 10 ghosts to bombard random enemies for 10s. Each ghost deals 110% + 15% ATK damage to an enemy target. When a ghost deals damage, Shemira heals herself for 50% + 5% of the damage dealt. When the ghost returns to her, she heals herself again for 50% + 5% of that damage. The percentage of the ghosts' damage drops to 50% once any enemy has been struck 15 times or more by the ghosts. The strike count resets whenever Shemira casts her Ultimate.
幽魂造成的伤害提升至120% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each ghost to 120% + 15% ATK.
幽魂造成的伤害提升至130% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each ghost to 130% + 15% ATK.
幽魂造成的伤害提升至140% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each ghost to 140% + 15% ATK.
幽魂造成的伤害提升至150% + 15% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by each ghost to 150% + 15% ATK.
对直线范围内的敌人造成伤害。
Shemira sacrifices her HP to deal damage to enemies in a straight line.
雪米拉消耗当前生命的10%，从4格外的幽冥裂隙中召唤悲怆宝珠，对飞行路径上的敌人造成320% + 40% ATK伤害。
Shemira sacrifices 10% of her current HP to summon the Wailing Orb from the spectral rift 4 tiles away, dealing 320% + 40% ATK damage to enemies in its path.
造成的伤害提升至340% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 340% + 40% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至360% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 360% + 40% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至380% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 380% + 40% ATK.
消耗生命造成伤害，消耗幽魂将造成额外范围伤害。
Shemira sacrifices her HP to deal damage. She can also sacrifice ghosts to deal extra AoE damage.
雪米拉消耗当前生命的15%，对单个敌方单位造成其最大生命值24% + 3%真实伤害，最高不超过自身800% ATK。若雪米拉拥有幽魂，则消耗1道幽魂，牵引幽冥之力对目标及周围1格敌方造成其最大生命值20% + 2%真实伤害，最高不超过自身500% ATK。被动地，我方消耗的生命或护盾达到雪米拉生命上限的50%时，在雪米拉身侧凝聚1道幽魂，至多存在5道幽魂。

Passive. Whenever allies' HP or shield value loss reaches 50% of Shemira's max HP, she summons 1 ghost to her side. Shemira can summon up to 5 ghosts outside her Ultimate.
Active. Shemira sacrifices 15% of her current HP to deal true damage to a single enemy equal to 24% + 3% of their max HP. This damage cannot exceed 800% ATK. If Shemira has any ghost summoned, she sacrifices one to strike the target and enemies within 1 tile of the target, dealing true damage equal to 20% + 2% of their max HP. The damage each enemy takes cannot exceed 500% ATK.
对单个敌方单位造成的最大生命值伤害提升至26% + 3%。
Increases the damage dealt to a single enemy to 26% + 3% of their max HP.
对单个敌方单位造成的最大生命值伤害提升至28% + 3%。
Increases the damage dealt to a single enemy to 28% + 3% of their max HP.
对单个敌方单位造成的最大生命值伤害提升至30% + 3%。
Increases the damage dealt to a single enemy to 30% + 3% of their max HP.
提高自身攻击回能，召唤3道幽魂后额外提升攻击回能。
Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases even further.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升24%，召唤3道幽魂后额外提升6%攻击回能。
Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases by 24% during battle. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases by an extra 6%.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升32%，召唤3道幽魂后额外提升8%攻击回能。
Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases by 32% during battle. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases by an extra 8%.
战斗中，自身攻击回能提升40%，召唤3道幽魂后额外提升10%攻击回能。
Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases by 40% during battle. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases by an extra 10%.
将幽魂转化为护盾，溢出护盾将转化为全场范围伤害。
Shemira sacrifices a ghost to gain a shield. When the shield expires, she unleashes the remaining power of the shield to deal damage to all enemies.
累计受到生命上限30%伤害或召唤幽魂达到上限后，会消耗1道幽魂生成护盾，持续5秒，护盾能够抵挡雪米拉250% ATK伤害，持续时间结束时，雪米拉将剩余的护盾能量宣泄而出，对全场敌人造成等同于剩余护盾量的伤害。

Whenever Shemira takes a total of 30% of her max HP in damage or reaches the max number of summoned ghosts, she sacrifices 1 ghost to gain a shield that lasts for 5s. The shield can absorb 250% ATK damage. When the shield expires, Shemira unleashes its remaining power against all enemies, dealing damage equal to the shield's remaining value.
护盾抵挡的伤害提高至270% ATK。
Increases the shield value to 270% ATK.
幽魂攻击时会额外造成目标最大生命值3%真实伤害，最高不超过自身90% ATK，并造成等同于伤害量的生命削减。

When a ghost attacks its target during Shemira's Ultimate, it deals extra true damage equal to 3% of the target's max HP. This damage cannot exceed 90% ATK. The attack also inflicts max HP reduction, lowering the target's max HP by the amount of damage dealt.
护盾抵挡的伤害提高至300% ATK。
Increases the shield value to 300% ATK.
英雄单位死亡时，获得一道幽魂。
Each time a hero is defeated, Shemira summons a ghost.
每个英雄单位死亡时，雪米拉额外获得1道幽魂。
Each time a hero is defeated, Shemira summons 1 ghost.
